note: EkGuru's level ladder. CEFR has SIX levels: A1, A2, B1, B2, C1, C2. Prakash asked for A1-A3, B1-B3, C1-C5 — eleven rungs. There is no A3 and no C3 to C5 on the CEFR scale, and a site that prints 'C4' on a page is a site an examiner stops trusting. The eleven rungs below are the honest version of the same request: the six real levels plus the half-step after each of the first five, written the way language schools write them (A1+ is a recognised label). Eleven rungs, one name each, no invented certificate.

rungs.label: A1
rungs.name: A1 · First words
rungs.can: greet, count to twenty, read a shop sign

rungs.label: A1+
rungs.name: A1+ · Getting around
rungs.can: ask for things, give a phone number, name the days

rungs.label: A2
rungs.name: A2 · Everyday sentences
rungs.can: talk about your day, shop, order food

rungs.label: A2+
rungs.name: A2+ · Holding a chat
rungs.can: keep a conversation going, tell a short story

rungs.label: B1
rungs.name: B1 · Independent
rungs.can: explain a problem, write a message, follow a podcast

rungs.label: B1+
rungs.name: B1+ · Comfortable
rungs.can: work in the language, argue a point politely

rungs.label: B2
rungs.name: B2 · Fluent enough
rungs.can: read a newspaper, write a real letter, joke

rungs.label: B2+
rungs.name: B2+ · Professional
rungs.can: run a meeting, read a contract, disagree well

rungs.label: C1
rungs.name: C1 · Nuance
rungs.can: idiom, register, tone — and hear when it is wrong

rungs.label: C1+
rungs.name: C1+ · Almost native
rungs.can: write for work, translate, teach a beginner

rungs.label: C2
rungs.name: C2 · Mastery
rungs.can: poetry, law, humour, and the mistake that sounds foreign

child.means: the visual on the page is a child
